description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatMarkdownPreprocessor module, verifying its behavior in parsing and cleaning Markdown input, handling images, metadata, and formatting.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessorTests
classes.description: A test suite struct containing multiple test cases to verify ChatMarkdownPreprocessor functionality.

methods.name: extractsDataURLImages
methods.description: Tests extraction of Base64-encoded images embedded as data URLs in Markdown.

methods.name: flattensRemoteMarkdownImagesIntoText
methods.description: Tests the preprocessing that removes remote image links and keeps the alt text.

methods.name: usesFallbackTextForUnlabeledRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Checks fallback to default text when image URL lacks alt text.

methods.name: handlesUnicodeBeforeRemoteMarkdownImages
methods.description: Ensures Unicode characters preceding image syntax are preserved correctly.

methods.name: stripsInboundUntrustedContextBlocks
methods.description: Verifies removal of JSON code blocks from untrusted context sections in Markdown.

methods.name: stripsSingleConversationInfoBlock
methods.description: Verifies removal of a single conversation info JSON block.

methods.name: stripsAllKnownInboundMetadataSentinels
methods.description: Checks that known metadata section headers and their JSON blocks are removed.

methods.name: preservesNonMetadataJsonFence
methods.description: Ensures JSON code blocks not related to metadata are preserved.

methods.name: stripsLeadingTimestampPrefix
methods.description: Tests removal of timestamp prefixes from the start of markdown lines.

methods.name: stripsEnvelopeHeadersAndMessageIdHints
methods.description: Removes envelope headers and message ID hints from markdown text.

methods.name: stripsTrailingUntrustedContextSuffix
methods.description: Removes untrusted context suffix sections from the markdown.

methods.name: preservesUntrustedContextHeaderWhenItIsUserContent
methods.description: Ensures untrusted context sections are preserved if they contain user content, not metadata.
